content:
There’s now a physical Apple pin for Lil Finder Guy, the adorable Finder-based Mac mascot who originated from MacBook Neo’s marketing campaign.

Canoopsy shared photos of Apple’s WWDC 2026 attendee swag bag on social media.

Included in the collection this year is a tote bag, water bottle, set of stickers, and enamel pins.

Apple similarly celebrated these symbols with virtual stickers inside this year’s Apple Developer app.

However, Lil Finder Guy waited for this limited edition pin pack to make an appearance.

  • Apple creates adorable little Finder guy to promote its adorable little Mac
  • Watch new MacBook Neo ads starring Little Finder Guy
  • Download these super-cute Little Finder Guy 5K wallpapers
  • Lil Finder Guy pet was the gateway to building my own Mac apps with Codex

WWDC 2026 kicks off tomorrow with the big iOS 27 and macOS 27 keynote at 10 am PT/1 pm ET.

9to5Mac will be in attendance, so stay tuned for all the news out of Cupertino all week long!
